mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (in percent) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d forward returns is greater than or equal to -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market slowdown, defined as the unemployment rate rising above 4.5% in the past three months, signals an impending economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the current month
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS does not lead to negative 60d returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO < 100), a contraction in industrial production signals reduced corporate output capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the annualized CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals an impending monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During a tight labor market (UNRATE below 4.0%), a strong payroll growth (PAYEMS above 200k) signals robust consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market boom (HOUST above 1200k) signals strong consumer confidence and increased home equity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index (INDPRO) signals stronger manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and 5d forward returns is less than 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.
